dataset: Official LOBSTER five-level public sample files
target: mid-price direction over the next 100 book events; flat when the move is within half a cent (50 LOBSTER price units)

models.queue_imbalance_logistic: C=0.1, balanced classes, top-level and five-level queue imbalance
models.engineered_logistic: C=0.1, balanced classes, standardized seven-feature set

strategy_counterfactual.decision: take the predicted up/down class; skip predicted stationary
strategy_counterfactual.entry: marketable sweep of up to five displayed levels after 1, 10, or 50 events
strategy_counterfactual.exit: opposite-side sweep 100 events after entry; residual shares marked to mid
strategy_counterfactual.position_overlap: prevented; next signal is considered after the prior exit
strategy_counterfactual.limits: event-count delay is not measured latency; impact beyond five levels is omitted; one-day counterfactual only

passive_queue_proxy.entry: post at displayed bid for predicted up moves and displayed ask for predicted down moves
passive_queue_proxy.queue_ahead: displayed top-level depth times 1x, 2x, or 4x stress multiplier
passive_queue_proxy.queue_depletion: visible executions at exact price and side only; cancellations ignored
passive_queue_proxy.exit: five-level taker sweep after the 100-event horizon; residual marked to mid
passive_queue_proxy.limitations: aggregate conservative queue-ahead proxy, not exact FIFO or order-ID replay; no maker rebates

feature_output: little-endian float64 records including message identifiers, event prices, and five book levels; column order defined by FEATURE_COLUMNS in src/run_lobster_sample.py
limitations: not a distribution-shift or persistence claim
event-count delay is not measured latency
passive queue proxy is not exact FIFO replay
counterfactual five-level sweep is not a full execution model
